notes.note: 'Paste it, get a verdict in plain words' is the rare product people will actually forward to their parents — the distribution is the product. Seniors lose $3B+/year, so the moral case writes the marketing. The $199/mo senior-living tier is where the money is; the free family tool is the funnel.
